description:
Point-in-time fundamentals for `ticker` as known on `as_of_date` (YYYY-MM-DD).
Returns each available metric's value for the fiscal period with source + knowledge time +
lineage under `metrics`. Any requested metric with no value appears under `unavailable` with
`{reason, code, available_alternatives, docs_url}` instead of being silently dropped. `code` is
`not_reported` or `financials_family`. `revenue` keeps the headline tag first filed for that
period (including `RevenuesNetOfInterestExpense` for brokers and card issuers) and follows
that tag's own restatements. A later tag does not replace it, and components are not summed.
A financial with only component lines gets `financials_family` and the populated members.
Check `unavailable` before concluding a figure does not exist.
`cost_of_revenue` keeps the cost tag first filed for the period. Candidate order is
CostOfRevenue, CostOfGoodsAndServicesSold, CostOfGoodsSold, CostOfServices. An empty
higher-priority tag does not block a later tag. Product cost and service cost are not
added together. `eps_basic` is EarningsPerShareBasic. `ebit` is not a us-gaap tag.
A missing Q2 or Q3 operating-cash-flow or capex quarter can be a year-to-date difference.
A missing Q4 flow quarter can be FY minus Q1, Q2, and Q3, with provenance "derived" and a
`derivation` object. EPS and share counts are not derived. Balance-sheet Q4 is the FY instant.

as_of_date.description: Knowledge date, YYYY-MM-DD. Returns the version of each value that was public on that date. Later restatements are excluded.

fiscal_period.description: FY, Q1, Q2, Q3, or Q4. Default FY. A missing Q4 income or cash-flow figure may be derived as FY minus the quarters, or as a year-to-date difference, and then includes a derivation object. EPS and share counts are not derived. Balance-sheet Q4 is the FY instant.

fiscal_year.description: Fiscal year. If omitted, the latest period of the requested fiscal_period known on as_of_date is returned.

metrics.description: Metric names to return. Examples: revenue, cost_of_revenue, gross_profit, operating_income, net_income, eps_diluted, operating_cash_flow, capex, total_assets, total_liabilities, stockholders_equity, cash, long_term_debt, shares_outstanding, weighted_avg_shares_basic, weighted_avg_shares_diluted. Names with no value come back under unavailable and are never zero. For banks, brokers and insurers, revenue may be unavailable with code financials_family and as-reported alternatives.

ticker.description: Issuer ticker as used by PtData, for example AAPL or GE.

name: get_fundamentals
title: Get point-in-time fundamentals
